segments.text:
V. 33.
So•e amaze•
—The Original Word imports the moſt ſhocking Amazement mingled with Grief: And that Word in the next Verſe which we render ſorrowful, intimates. That he was ſurrounded with ſorrow on every Side, breaking in upon him with ſuch Violence, as was ready to ſeparate his Soul from his Body.
